Alicia / Peter,

Following up on the thread below and the proposed timelines from your team. We appreciate the VAT clarification request and have attached the corrected VAT annex and an updated PDF invoice (same total). To keep things aligned and avoid operational impact to Acme Health, here's what we propose:

1) Corrected documents sent (attached). Please confirm receipt.
2) Payment target: 2026-09-08 EOD PT for the full outstanding amount.
3) If Acme cannot meet that date, sign and return the attached two-installment payment plan by 2026-09-06 COB. The terms: 50% due by 9/08, remainder due by 9/18.
4) If neither condition is met, we will place the additional capacity on hold on 9/09 and may initiate a billing hold on 9/12 until cleared.

We value our partnership and prefer a simple fix that avoids escalation. Peter — if it helps, Vivek and I are available for a 15-minute call tomorrow to remove any blockers.

Thanks,
